notes: Which occurrence survives / output order: keep-first in input order (C1, C6) vs keep-last in input order (C2) vs sorted ascending like a set (C3).
Scope of 'duplicate': anywhere in the list (C1,C2,C3,C5,C6) vs only adjacent repeats, Unix-uniq style (C4).
Does one copy survive or are repeated values removed entirely? C5 keeps only values that occur exactly once; all others keep one copy.
Type strictness: bool/float subclasses silently collapse into their int equals (C1-C5, e.g. True==1) vs TypeError on non-int elements (C6).
